_note: A manifest that can survive a model release. Every component names an exact artifact, replays a frozen probe set, keeps a human or a shadow run between a release and users, and records the toolchain it was verified with.

components._why: The reasoning seat. Shadow-run every release before it reaches a user.
Called over HTTP with no vendor client, so runtime is explicitly null — a decision on the record, not an omission.
Second vendor on purpose — the manifest is the one place that shows the whole spread.
